mapping.draft_py:
# Seize the Spoils: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card. Draw two cards and
# create a Treasure token."
# The compiler's SpellAbility keeps its additional cost (CostDiscard, B5a-addl-cost-discard) and
# gets the effect: DRAW 2 of you, then CREATE_TOKEN of one Treasure (the corpus' spec, M21 Gadrak;
# FDN Gleaming Barrier). The compiled card keyword TREASURE (MTGJSON) is kept.
treasure = TokenSpec(
    name='Treasure',
    type_line='Artifact',
    types=('Artifact',),
    subtypes=(),
    power=None,
    toughness=None,
    keywords=(Keyword.TREASURE,),
    abilities=(
        ActivatedAbility(
            cost=Cost(parts=(
                CostSacrifice(target=Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                )),
                CostTap(),
            )),
            effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'color': 'ANY', 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    ),
)
carrier = compiled[0]
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        additional_costs=carrier.additional_costs,
        effect=Seq(steps=(
            A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
            A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {'count': QConst(value=1), 'tokens': treasure}),
        )),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards and create a Treasure token.

mapping.notes: The compiler's carrier keeps its additional cost (discard a card); its effect is DRAW 2, then one Treasure (spec as M21 Gadrak). MTGJSON keyword TREASURE kept.

clauses.clause: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
clauses.evidence: Every [cast] variant: 'ask discard' first, offering the six other hand cards (never the spell itself), the pick moves hand -> graveyard BEFORE 'card moves hand -> stack', mana C-2 R-1. Pack B08_3 PASSES (with no other card in hand the cast is refused 'cost:discard', nothing drawn, mana kept) and B08_1 (the chosen card is discarded as the cost).
Every [cast] variant: 'you draws you:Library 5#1' and 'you draws you:Library 4#1', 'you: library 6 -> 4' (exactly two, for you). Pack B08_1 PASSES (hand 3 = spare + two drawn).

clauses.clause: create a Treasure token (an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
clauses.evidence: Trace: 'you:Treasure moves new -> battlefield (by card/CREATE_TOKEN)', '+ you:Treasure (battlefield, you, TREASURE)': one Treasure under your control. The token's own ability is never used in the trace. Packs PASS: B08_1 (exactly one Treasure) and B08_2 (the only mana left is the new Treasure: it pays Giant Growth, is sacrificed, leaves no mana over, the Bear is 5/5). Wrong twins fail.
